alert_name: Datadog Monitor: [CRITICAL] cart-api Database Connection Pool Starvation
subject: [Datadog] [P2] cart-api HikariPool Connection Timeout on production

details.error_message: HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available, request timed out after 30002ms.
symptoms: Cart checkout latency spiked from 120ms to 32,000ms

message: The cart-api service on host prod-cart-worker-01.corp.internal reported severe HikariPool connection starvation. Database query leases are not being released in a timely manner. Investigate Splunk logs for slow transactions and connection leaks.
